body_html: Laura and Aaron looked BEAUTIFUL last evening! I must say the Alexan Events staff did a PHENOMENAL job transfering the TIVOLI center into another REALM!! It went from industrial to MODERN BEAUTY in an effortless transition that seemed like it took only minutes! Bryan from JAMMIN DJ’S was a PROFESSIONAL and OUTSTANDING Host/DJ! The whole evening was SEAMLESS and we were able to play EVEY SINGLE SONG THE BRIDE AND GROOM REQUESTED!! I thought the food was GOOD (and if I continue to work weddings I’m gonna get FAT) but it truly was the EVENT STAFF and BRYAN EVANS that really made the night MEMORABLE!!
